method: Shadow Walk is Emily's power only. The coverage harness grants it by name (lab only) and the source enters the form, crawls forward and leaves it with the product controller in the Dunwall tower safe room (coverage-v1359e); the takedown harness approaches tutorial guard 2 from behind in the form and attacks (the form's kill, assassination_sw_back_short, id 38) or chokes (choke_sw_back, id 77) him (takedown-variants-v1254zd). The source reads the native Shadow Walk scenes in the form's own state mode (stance 2; 1214db) and sends power variants 32-36, and the form's kill and choke as takedown ids 37-44 and 77-84; the partner presents the authored crawl (bank clips, visual sweep 1260) and the native takedown scenes. The native form has no third-person body: survey 1381b filmed native material effects on the partner and effect 1, a complete matte black silhouette, was chosen; 1214di applies it while variants 32-36 are presented (fading in over the entry and out over the exit) and 1214dj holds it through the form's kill and choke. The native Shadow Walk particles follow the partner (1214cz). A case passes when the partner presentation stays live, the form phases are presented at full weight and recovered, and for the attacks when the outcome is shared in both worlds.

items.scope: Emily's Shadow Walk on the partner: entry, the crawl while moving, the form's kill and choke, and the exit, in the native black material silhouette, recovering to her ordinary body.

visual.verdict: Emily drops from standing into the Shadow Walk crawl and becomes a matte black silhouette with the native smoke around her, crawls forward on all fours, then rises and is back in her ordinary colours as the form ends.

From the form behind the guard, Emily as a black silhouette seizes him and throws him overhead; he crashes down dead and she straightens in her ordinary colours. Her sword's ring guard stays lit in her hand during the throw (the sword is a separate entity outside the material).
From the form, Emily as a black silhouette pulls the guard down to his knees from behind, then holds him down in her ordinary colours until he goes limp.
